Orbit **1.1.2** — Fix Steam sign-in startup and cancellation

## Fixed

- An already-stopped Wine server no longer blocks Steam from opening. Wine returns code 1 for a kill request when there is no server; Orbit now confirms shutdown with a bounded server wait instead of treating that case as a fatal error.
- Cancel releases the sign-in modal even if native cleanup fails. Cleanup errors appear as notifications, so the user can retry.
- Native shutdown has bounded waits and rejects failed monitoring instead of waiting indefinitely.

## Install

Use `Orbit-1.1.2-aarch64.dmg` on Apple Silicon Macs. This local build is ad-hoc signed;
checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. It supersedes the local 1.1.1 build.

The shutdown regression was verified against the installed Wine binary in an
isolated prefix, covering both running and absent servers without opening a UI.
Completing Steam account sign-in and God of War playability remain unverified.
